_comment: Narration script for the demo video. One entry per scene. Each phrase is synthesised separately so the pauses between complete thoughts are exact. 'say' is what the TTS engine reads (pronunciation only); 'text' is what is written in the captions. 'lead' and 'tail' are the seconds of silence before and after the narration inside each scene. 'voice' is the narration of the video in docs/video: engine 'file' (one ElevenLabs take cut into phrases), 'elevenlabs' (API; needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY), 'piper' (local) or 'sapi' (Windows). 'voice_elevenlabs_api' and 'voice_piper_first_version' are ready alternatives.

voice.describe: ElevenLabs text-to-speech, stock voice George (model Eleven Multilingual v2)
voice.settings: ElevenLabs web app defaults: speed 1.0, stability 50 %, similarity 75 %, style 0; MP3 44.1 kHz 128 kb/s; first of two generations
